svg.title: Every column that entered one of the specimen's LayerNorms, drawn as its journey onto the sphere.
svg.desc: 9120 centred columns x̃ (80 per LayerNorm × 3 LayerNorms × 38 moments of training, AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1). Each stroke runs radially (radius ∝ log(1 + length)) from |x̃| to |x̂| = |x̃|/σ, which is just inside √D = 2.828; its angle is the direction of x̃ projected onto the plane of the two leading principal directions of all centred columns. Value ink: the trained model. The circle is not drawn; it is where the strokes end.
